<script>
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
		// Run the check function on page load
		checkVariantAndHide();

		// Get the select element inside the options-selection__select-wrapper
		const selectElement = document.querySelector(
			'.options-selection__select-wrapper .options-selection__input-select'
		);

		// Add an event listener to the select element to trigger on change
		if (selectElement) {
			selectElement.addEventListener('change', () => {
				checkVariantAndHide();
			});
		}
	});

	function checkVariantAndHide() {
		// Create a URLSearchParams object from the current URL's query string
		const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
		const variant = params.get('variant');

		// Check if the 'variant' parameter is not '46214072500438' and is not null
		if (variant !== '46214072500438' && variant !== null) {
			// Select the divs with the specified data-image attributes for the first variant
			const firstVariantDivs = document.querySelectorAll(
				'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/04-52020.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728389437&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/04-52020.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728389437&width=266"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Professional-Grade.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728420921&width=266"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Professional-Grade.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728420921&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Prong-Remote-Dock_1.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728476685&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Prong-Remote-Dock_1.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728476685&width=266"]'
			);

			// Hide these divs if the variant does not match
			firstVariantDivs.forEach((div) => {
				div.style.display = 'none';
			});
		} else {
			// Show the divs if the variant matches or is not present
			const firstVariantDivs = document.querySelectorAll(
				'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/04-52020.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728389437&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/04-52020.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728389437&width=266"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Professional-Grade.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728420921&width=266"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Professional-Grade.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728420921&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Prong-Remote-Dock_1.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728476685&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/52020-Prong-Remote-Dock_1.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728476685&width=266"]'
			);

			firstVariantDivs.forEach((div) => {
				div.style.display = ''; // Resets to the default display
			});
		}

		// Check if the 'variant' parameter is not '46214075613398' and is not null
		if (variant !== '46214075613398' && variant !== null) {
			// Select the divs with the specified data-image attributes for the second variant
			const secondVariantDivs = document.querySelectorAll(
				'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/05-52019_c32f3ab9-a6f5-49e9-b784-1abc3ed1891e.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728395652&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/05-52019_c32f3ab9-a6f5-49e9-b784-1abc3ed1891e.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728395652&width=266"]'
			);

			// Hide these divs if the variant does not match
			secondVariantDivs.forEach((div) => {
				div.style.display = 'none';
			});
		} else {
			// Show the divs if the variant matches or is not present
			const secondVariantDivs = document.querySelectorAll(
				'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/05-52019_c32f3ab9-a6f5-49e9-b784-1abc3ed1891e.png?crop=center&height=560&v=1728395652&width=560"], ' +
					'div[data-image="//muleproducts.com/cdn/shop/files/05-52019_c32f3ab9-a6f5-49e9-b784-1abc3ed1891e.png?crop=center&height=266&v=1728395652&width=266"]'
			);

			secondVariantDivs.forEach((div) => {
				div.style.display = ''; // Resets to the default display
			});
		}
	}
</script>
